vb_textbox.text: I realised that the best colours to pick appear to go in runs and the flip. Sometimes the lighter hats are best, then after about 10-15 goes it flips to the darker hats being best. When the mushroom count declines below around 4 it might be time to switch colour. I had a feeling that perhaps the lighter hats were more successful in terms of length of time (for longer runs) than the darker hats, but I'm not certain. It seems there might also be periods when all the woods have few mushrooms (like 1 or 2), regardless of which colour you pick.
